messages:
Alex Chen: Heads up — proposing a small tweak to the next release train window because of the two overlapping holidays in EU. Thinking we stagger the handoff days instead of moving the whole train. :calendar:
Priya Patel: Staggered sounds good to me. Can you sketch who owns which days? also need to confirm cutoff implications for semantic version bumps.
Samir Rao: Quick note: if we shift owners, the changelog editor needs to land earlier so we can run the automated sanity checks. I can open a tiny PR to pin the changelog template to the train date.
Alex Chen: Proposed split: Day 0 (deploy prep): PST owner, Day 1 (release day): CET owner, Day 2 (post-release support): APAC owner. That gives overlap windows for handoffs at 08:00 UTC and 20:00 UTC.
Jamie Wong: That overlap timing is reasonable. For the version bump, we should keep the cutoff at 23:59 UTC on Day 0. Anything merged after cutoff goes to next train. Means people need to schedule CI merges earlier on Day 0.
Priya Patel: Agree on the cutoff rule. Can we add an automatic reminder in #eng-releases 24h and 2h before cutoff? Also will ops-bot still run the release tagging?
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled — 24h and 2h before 2025-05-14T23:59:00Z (cutoff).
Samir Rao: ops-bot thanks. For tagging we use this command in the release script:
```
./scripts/release.sh --tag release/vX.Y.Z --changelog CHANGELOG.md
```
I’ll update the script to emit a warning when PR contains breaking changes but bump type is not set.
Alex Chen: Good call. Also adding a short handover checklist in the handoff doc: link: <https://redwood.internal/docs/release-handoffs/staggered-2025-05>
Checklist highlights: owner contact, primary rollback step, 3-minute health-check query, critical routes to monitor.
Jamie Wong: Can we add a small note about branch protection? On the train week we should relax the 'merge into main only from release branch' rule one hour before cutoff so hotfixes can land, then re-enable. That avoids long blocking PRs.
Priya Patel: I’d prefer policy change be explicit: add a small window policy entry in the handoff doc plus an automatic message when protection toggles. ops-bot can post who toggled it.
ops-bot: Branch protection toggle automation added to the plan. It will tag the actor in the message.
Samir Rao: I’ll draft the tiny changelog PR and ping reviewers @Jamie @Alex. Also will create a test entry in the eval suite to ensure the changelog parser accepts the new staggered date format.
Alex Chen: Thanks. Action items: Samir — changelog PR + parser test; Priya — set reminder schedule and verify notifications; Jamie — update branch-protection window; Me (Alex) — publish handoff doc and coordinate owner roster.
Priya Patel: I'll put the reminder cron in infra and send a calendar invite to the rotation owners. Will also add a short blurb to the release notes template about which owner covered what.
Jamie Wong: One more: please add a fallback plan if the CET owner is unavailable — fallback goes to PST owner automatically via rotation policy. Add that to the handoff doc under "Fallback & Escalation".
Alex Chen: Will do. If nobody objects by EOD tomorrow I'll lock the schedule and send the calendar invites. :thumbsup: 
Priya Patel: No objections from me.
Samir Rao: LGTM.
Jamie Wong: LGTM.
release-bot: release-reminder created for 2025-05-14T23:59:00Z (cutoff) and 2025-05-16T08:00:00Z (release day handoff).
